about: Congress's regular session each year: it convenes at noon on January 3 unless a law sets another day (U.S. Const. amend. XX, sec. 2), and its last scheduled votes come in mid-December. A year past the table repeats the latest one's month and day, marked ESTIMATED.

2025.source: Convening: U.S. Const. amend. XX, sec. 2 (the 119th Congress convened January 3, 2025). Last votes: the House Majority Leader's 2025 calendar schedules its final votes the week of December 15; spread December 12 to December 23.

2026.source: U.S. Const. amend. XX, sec. 2; the last votes of a second session usually fall in the third week of December (House calendars, 2016 to 2024); spread December 11 to December 22.

2027.source: U.S. Const. amend. XX, sec. 2; last votes as in recent first sessions (House calendars, 2017 to 2025); spread December 10 to December 21.
